page.layout: Running head across the top; two parallel columns of glossary entries (left and right) above a rule; below the rule a title block with heading, then a two-column list of names; a marginal note in the left margin near the bottom. Show-through and stains ignored.

main_text.head: CATALOGVS NOMINVM PROPRIORVM, QVIBVS *ALAMANNI quondam appellati, Ex vetustissimo Codice Monasterii S. Galli ordine descriptus.
CAPVT I.

p.i: De hominibus propriis masculinis in Alamannia Thetonica.

main_text.p: Alfrid. Aaron, Aron. Abo, Abbo, Abbi. Adalbero, Adalpeto. Adalbern.
Adalbert, Adalpret, Adalcho. dalprehr, Adalpert, Adalcoz, Adelgolz, Adal goz. delpret, Adilpert, Adalfrid. delprech, Albrecht, Alprecht. Adalgan. Adalboldy Adalger, Adalker. Adalgis
*Qui nlicalie nu magis quā suis ac proprii deleantur.

page.notes: Left margin note in italic, partly obscured, reads roughly "Qui nlicalie nu magis quā suis ac proprii deleantur." Bottom-left mark "abV" and "LIL" appear to be printer's or show-through marks and are omitted. Many readings in the right column are damaged by stains and show-through; uncertain forms are approximate. Heading text "Catalogus" and the "Thetonica" line are partly obscured.
